title: Speciesist Language and Nonhuman Animal Bias in English Masked Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Template-based evaluation measuring differences in masked word probabilities and sentiment when animals are referred to with human-describing versus object-describing pronouns, and a corpus-based evaluation calculating the predicted probability of models filling masked tokens with object-related ('that', 'which') versus human-related ('who', 'whom') relative pronouns.
